2609.22719.title: From Code to Requirements: Agentic Reverse Engineering of Business Rules at Enterprise Scale
2609.22719.paper_summary: Business requirements for enterprise software systems are rarely captured in structured form; the logic resides instead in source code, configuration files, and institutional memory. When these systems must be migrated, extended, or audited, the absence of formal requirements artifacts forces teams into expensive, knowledge-losing manual reverse engineering. This paper presents an agentic framework that autonomously generates Business Requirements Documents (bRDs) through reverse engineering of undocumented enterprise software. Seven specialized agents collaborate to discover user journeys, extract business rules, and synthesize a locked bRD from code, test suites, configuration, and available documentation, supported by static analysis tools, guided by embedded expert practitioner cognitive models, and overseen by human reviewers at controlled escalation points. Measured on actual execution traces across a real enterprise deployment, the framework generates comprehensive bRDs in under nine minutes per service, with extracted rules independently corroborated against real production defect records. In a comparable prior migration to the same target architecture, delivery required over two years; on the present programme the framework achieves a cost reduction exceeding 98% against a baseline derived from actual repository metrics using IFPUG complexity models and industry benchmark labor rates.
2609.22719.paper_summary_zh: 企業軟體系統的商業需求很少以結構化的形式捕捉；邏輯則存在於源代碼、配置文件和組織記憶中。當這些系統必須進行遷移、擴展或審計時，缺乏正式的需求文檔迫使團隊進行昂貴且會失去知識的手動逆向工程。本文提出了一個自主生成商業需求文檔（bRDs）的代理框架，通過對未記錄的企業軟體進行逆向工程。七個專門的代理協作發現用戶旅程，提取商業規則，並從代碼、測試套件、配置和可用文檔中合成一個鎖定的bRD，這一過程得到靜態分析工具的支持，並受嵌入的專家實踐者認知模型指導，並由人類審核者在控制的升級點進行監督。根據實際企業部署中的執行痕跡進行測量，該框架每個服務生成全面的bRD所需時間不到九分鐘，提取的規則與實際生產缺陷記錄獨立核實。在之前的類似遷移到相同目標架構中，交付需要超過兩年；而在本計劃中，該框架實現了超過98%的成本減少，這是基於使用IFPUG複雜度模型和行業基準勞動率的實際倉庫指標得出的基線。
